before.requirement: Deliver an XInclude error to a structured handler registered on the XInclude context.
before.reason: The before context has no handler fields, its error producer passes no handler or user data, and the verified preimage has no context-handler setter.

struct _xmlXIncludeCtxt {
    xmlDocPtr             doc; /* the source document */
    int                 incNr; /* number of includes */

after.requirement: When an XInclude context has a registered structured handler and a relevant error occurs, deliver that error to the stored handler with its user data.
after.reason: The setter stores the handler and user data, and xmlXIncludeErr passes both to __xmlRaiseError. The old harness does not call the setter. The supplied control flow does not yet prove a feasible fuzz-input path to that error producer or establish the callback dispatch.
